title: Party inventory in one list
summary: Funds & inventory now lists each item once, with an action menu on every row, and players see their coins and Give at the top.
items: Each item has one row with its holder, quantity and value, and a ⋯ menu: Edit, Give, Move to pool, Sell to shop and Remove.
Group by holder or category, filter by holder, category or Equipped, and search.
Select several items to give, pool or remove them; each is its own action, and Resume finishes a run interrupted by a reload without repeating anything.
Editing an item uses a Save button instead of saving when you leave the field.
Players see their coins with Give right under Combined wealth, identical items as one row (Potion of healing ×3), and an Equipped chip.
